thought.text: The nginx proxies chat.arelorian.de to port 3000. External access is likely blocked by firewall. Let me check:

reasoning_content: The nginx is configured for chat.arelorian.de -> port 3000. But the user is trying to access via work-1 host which is different. That must be some kind of cloud proxy. Let me check if there's a firewall issue on the VPS or if they need to open port 3000.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Check firewall
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ufw status 2>&1 | head -10")
print("Firewall:", stdout.read().decode())

# Check iptables
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("iptables -L INPUT -n 2>&1 | head -15")
print("iptables:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
